title: First Year Seminar 101
description: A short first-year seminar that introduces new students to the university: academic expectations, campus resources, and study strategies.
notes: SBU: 1 credit; the sequence names no course code.

title: First Year Seminar 102
description: The second short first-year seminar, continuing the introduction to university life and academic skills.
notes: SBU: 1 credit; the sequence names no course code.

title: CSE 101 or CSE 103 (Computer Science Principles)
description: An introductory computing course for students with no programming experience: computational thinking, basic programming, and either the breadth of computer science or working with real data sets.
notes: Choice slot: SBU's CSE 101 (Computer Science Principles) or CSE 103 (Data Science Principles). Official descriptions are in data/raw/sbu/courses/.

title: Natural Science Course + Lab
description: A natural science lecture course with its laboratory, such as general physics, chemistry, or biology.

title: SBC
description: A general education course from the university's Stony Brook Curriculum, in an area such as humanities, social sciences, the arts, diversity, or global studies.
notes: SBU: SBC categories DIV, HUM, SBS, ARTS, USA, GLO.

title: AMS 210 or MAT 211 (Applied Linear Algebra)
description: A first linear algebra course: systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues, and applications.
notes: Choice slot: SBU's AMS 210 or MAT 211.

title: UD Technical Elective
description: An upper-division computer science course chosen by the student.
notes: SBU: six upper-division technical CSE courses.

title: Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.

title: UD Elective
description: An upper-division course chosen by the student, inside or outside the major.

title: CSE 416 or CSE 356 (Software Engineering)
description: A senior software course: software engineering methods and a team project, or building scalable online services in the cloud.
notes: Choice slot: SBU's CSE 416 (Software Engineering) or CSE 356 (Cloud Computing). Official descriptions are in data/raw/sbu/courses/.

title: Elective or SBC (SBS+ or HFA+)
description: A free elective, or a general education course in the social sciences or humanities and arts for students who take CSE 356 instead of CSE 416.
